item.title: Plans proceed to convert Milwaukee factory into housing
item.description: Developer Ken Breunig plans 47 apartments in a historic Menomonee Valley factory, pending Milwaukee Historic Preservation approval.

item.title: U.S. dollar could rebound after four-month slide
item.description: Analysts turn bullish on the U.S. dollar as growth improves and Fed fears ease, though some warn the currency could keep sliding.

item.title: Title inflation fuels decline of supervisor jobs
item.description: Census data show managers rising as supervisors decline, driven by title inflation, college degrees and overtime rules under the FLSA.

item.title: Insulation expert helps homeowners cut energy bills
item.description: Koala Insulation of Greenville helps homeowners cut energy bills 30–40% with attic insulation, air sealing and ventilation solutions.

item.title: Judge upholds Wisconsin DNR’s Line 5 reroute permit
item.description: A judge upheld Wisconsin DNR permits for Enbridge’s Line 5 reroute around Bad River tribal land, clearing the way for construction.

item.title: Advocacy group pushes for extended St. Cloud rail corridor
item.description: All Aboard Minnesota urges lawmakers to study expanding passenger rail from St. Cloud to Fargo, extending Amtrak’s Borealis route.

item.title: Just Sold: Process Displays executes sale leaseback
item.description: Process Displays completed a $10.275M sale leaseback of its Golden Valley plant. A Roseville industrial flex building sold for $14.8M.

item.title: Homebuilder sentiment subdued by affordability challenges
item.description: U.S. homebuilder sentiment slipped in February as high construction costs, tariffs and affordability woes kept buyers sidelined, NAHB says.

item.title: Rogers firm grows as CO2 heat pump debuts in St. Paul
item.description: Rogers-based Flow Environmental Systems expands as its CO2 heat pump launches at a St. Paul union training center, boosting clean energy jobs and manufacturing.

item.title: Minneapolis home sales plunge in January
item.description: Minneapolis closed home sales fell 31.7% in January, while statewide sales dropped 15.7%, according to Minnesota Realtors data.
